subject: Discovery call follow-up — schedule demo
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery call follow-up — schedule demo

Hi Alex,

Thanks for taking the time to speak today — really appreciated the context on Acme's ingestion pipeline and the latency targets you mentioned. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps: 

- Key notes:
  - Primary use case: near-real-time customer support routing + summarization (500–1,000 reqs/min peak)
  - Target P95 latency: <= 250ms for short responses, acceptable tradeoff for higher throughput using batching/quantization for large jobs
  - Compliance: SOC 2 required, data retention policy must support 90-day logs

Proposed next step: technical deep-dive + live demo of Redwood inference running on a sample workflow. Suggested slots (PT):
- Thu, Nov 25 — 09:00–10:00 PT (preferred)
- Tue, Nov 23 — 11:00–12:00 PT (alternate)

Please let me know which works for you and who from your team should join (we recommend your lead on data infra + the engineer owning the routing pipeline). I can loop in our SE, Dev Patel, to cover architecture and integration details.

Attached: Acme_Discovery_Slides.pdf (call notes) and redwood-capabilities-one-pager.pdf.

If Thursday works I can send a calendar invite with Zoom and an agenda.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0132
